name: Score and coach sales and service calls
summary: Scores and coaches sales and service calls. Crons read new call transcripts from Fireflies and voice-AI call logs from GoHighLevel, and draft a coaching note on the contact. The agent scores each call against one rubric. A coaching email to a rep is queued for a person to approve, never sent by a cron.

covered_by.score: skill (the agent writes a score per call)
covered_by.coach-feedback: coach (note on the contact, rep email queued)

crons.name: capture
crons.summary: New call transcripts from Fireflies and new voice-AI call logs from GoHighLevel, stored for scoring.

crons.name: coach
crons.summary: For each scored call: a coaching note on the GoHighLevel contact (drafted), and a coaching email to the rep (queued for approval).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads of transcripts and call logs, and one internal contact note in GoHighLevel. Nothing a customer or rep receives is a draft operation. The rep coaching email is a live operation and waits for a person.

fireflies.covers: transcript list and one transcript read (speakers, text, summary, action items)

gohighlevel.covers: voice-AI call logs with transcript (read), contact note (internal), rep email (queued)

gaps: Zoho and the custom CRM: no adapter. Zoho has operations in the kit but no call-coaching platform evidence was mined for it.
HubSpot: call records, transcripts and notes are mapped with support rated partial to yes, but no adapter is built in this pass. It is the next adapter to add.

GoHighLevel human-rep calls: the call logs cover voice-AI calls. Recordings and transcripts of human calls sit behind conversation messages (conversations.get-message-transcription), which need a conversation lookup that is not built.
Script check (10-step call structure): no platform checks a call against a script. This is a judgment step the agent can take from the transcript, not a cron.
Action items and next steps: neither platform has a mapped operation that creates a task from a call. The next step appears in the contact note and the rep email only.
Follow-up: whether coaching changed a rep's calls or results needs a later comparison of scores. Not built.

Score recording: the core runtime has no command that records a score (quoting has propose for its lines). The agent writes scores with a short script on the file store (see SKILL.md). A runtime command would be cleaner.
Rep email: each rep must exist as a GoHighLevel contact, and their Fireflies work email must match a key in settings.reps. Until then coaching stays in the store.
Credentials and accounts: both adapters are tested offline against a fake network only. Neither has run against a real account. Keys are FIREFLIES_API_KEY and GHL_ACCESS_TOKEN.
